data.name: Invisibility Trick
data.description: At 17th level, the urban ranger can cast improved invisibility on himself as a wizard of his ranger level as a swift action. He can use this spell-like ability a number of times per day equal to his Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). This ability replaces hide in plain sight.
